skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-mobile-keyboard

skills.name: qa-detect-modal-viewport-fit

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-orientation

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-overflow-controls
skills.description: Detects tab strips, segmented controls, and button groups whose children overflow horizontally without a visible scroll affordance
skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-reduced-motion

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-responsive-images

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-touch

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-typography-advanced

skills.name: qa-detect-typography-responsive

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-affordance

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-card-usage

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-cross-page-theme
skills.description: Detects color/theme drift ACROSS pages — sidebar background color changes between routes, header bar uses different hues on different pages, theme primary varies across the audit run, active-state color drifts. skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-format-consistency
skills.description: Detects mixed display formats for the same kind of data on a single page: date formats (5/6/2026 vs 2026-06-05 vs Jun 5 2026), currency formats (PKR 93M vs Rs. 93,000,000 vs $93M), number formats (1,000 vs 1.000 vs 1k), time formats (17:17 vs 5:17 PM), phone formats. skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-icons

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-nav-icons

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-overlap

skills.author: Luqman-Ud-Din

skills.name: qa-detect-ux-page-header
skills.description: Detects page-header layout problems — page title smaller than metric/content text (broken typographic hierarchy), page title sitting before the home icon in the breadcrumb row, page title text duplicated as a breadcrumb item, home icon not the first breadcrumb item, page title using same style as breadcrumb.
